page: Amazon Web Services x2iedn.16xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 64 vCPUs and 32 physical cores, utilizing dedicated Intel Xeon 8375C processors running at 3.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 2048.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing 32.0 GB of RAM per physical core. Local storage is bundled as a 1900 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and the network interface delivers a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 61947.26 and a Passmark CPU score of 56826.42. The instance demonstrates strong capabilities in database operations, scoring 26144.88 on Passmark database tests, and software compilation with a Geekbench clang score of 41744.0. Single-core performance remains average, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 1688.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1893.9. Memory bandwidth tests show average performance, with read-only small block cached bandwidth at 3352.15 GB/sec and large block uncached write bandwidth at 61.06 GB/sec.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 32:1 and integrated NVMe storage, this instance offers high resource density for memory-bound applications. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring massive in-memory datasets without the need for dedicated GPU acceleration. The combination of 2 TB of RAM, 50 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and local NVMe storage makes it highly suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching, enterprise applications, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
